spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: ¿Hasta cuándo ustedes se niegan a guardar mis mandamientos y mis torás?

findings.issue: תוֹרֹתַי is a common noun (feminine plural + 1cs suffix), and “torás” leaves that lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.

notes: The rest of the clause matches the tokens, including 2mp as ustedes.
